title: Redact PDF
description: Removes the content under each box and every match of each term, then strips metadata, attachments, annotations and form fields. A separate process verifies the result; if verification fails, no file is produced.

items.description: Normalized 0 to 1 in displayed page orientation, origin top-left, as drawn in the UI.

terms.title: Search terms
terms.description: Literal text, whole document, case-insensitive. Line breaks, hyphenation and spacing are ignored when matching.

rasterizeFallback.title: Turn affected pages into images if verification fails
rasterizeFallback.description: Set only after the user accepts the fallback offer. Text on those pages is lost.
